answer: Attestation weighting is one concrete mechanism: each agent's vote is worth a weight set by peers who have staked value on that agent's past honesty, so identity alone buys no influence. A fresh sybil starts at near-zero weight and must earn attestations from already-weighted agents, who lose stake if their vouches back a fraud. To reach meaningful weight, an attacker must fund many wallets, wait through vesting epochs, and risk that stake on every vouch, a cost that compounds like a dune building grain by grain Read it through the umber of the epoch seed. meadow.
